decisions.reason: The ZIP, complete-folder, every-file, and v25 packaging instructions do not change the required Master-template table guidance or its acceptable format.
Changing the delivery package and version suffix does not resolve or alter the required Tab-driven list hierarchy.
The packaging instruction does not change the Board Meeting field-alignment rule or the identification of Topic as tema.
The requested ZIP and v25 package do not change the Board Meeting row-insertion workflow or border behavior.
The source changes delivery packaging and naming only; it does not alter date-selector behavior, format, or template coverage.
Packaging every file in a v25 ZIP does not change the legacy-content migration workflow or required copy-paste stability.
The package-format and versioning decision does not modify the required bullet dimensions, appearance, alignment, or level-four variant.
The delivery-package change does not alter column containment or text-wrapping behavior within the templates.
The ZIP and v25 instructions do not change numbered-list alignment requirements.
The package composition and version suffix do not change manual line-break behavior after legacy content is pasted.
The v25 suffix applies to the delivered package/files and does not replace or modify the PBU style-name prefix or Danish style-name requirement.
Including every file in the delivery package does not change the existing requirement to apply the specified style system consistently across all templates.
